item.title: When agents write most of the code, the job is evidence
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. How many agents one person can run is set by whether that person can confirm the work without reading every diff. What follows is the version I ran, and what each kind of evidence can be fooled by. 1. The bottleneck moved from the keyboard to the confirmation# Start with the number I cannot check.

item.title: Cognitive surrender: hand off the work, not the judgement
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: handing over the work is fine. Handing over the judgement is a different act, and the slope between the two is quiet. English narration, 2 min 41 s. The Chinese cut runs 2 min 33 s with the same scenes and the same numbers. Addy Osmani published a long piece on X in November about keeping critical thinking while working with agents.
